text:
Alex: Heads-up, found a config drift in the embeddings KVCACHE feature that only started hitting prod after yesterday's autoscaler change. 5xxs for a small % of requests, working on a patch.
Sam: Can you scope? severity?
Alex: Low latency customers see errors <1% but noisy alerts. Root cause: old config key name leaked during rollout, fallback path throws. Patch is tiny, but we want to pin runtime to v2.14.3 and push a hotfix image 2.14.4.
Maria: Can we do a canary? traffic mix right now is heavy (change window ends in 20m). If canary runs it'll cut into capacity.
Alex: Plan: push 2.14.4 to staging (already running), smoke, then skip canary and do immediate pin-and-rollforward for prod if Sam +1 and SRE +1. We'll take manual rollback if anything odd. Need expedited approval.
Devon: Ops: what's the risk to autoscaler? If config's incompatible we'll see steady 5xxs, but autoscaler will respawn. We can set circuit-breaker to 0.1 for the route before rolling.
Alex: Good call. I'll set CB to 0.1, pin the model runtime, then deploy image. Rollback steps in release notes.
Jen: Product: any customer comms? small set, but we'll hold until rollback window used.
Alex: No public comms yet. will keep notif channel open.
Sam: Oncall +1 for expedited pin, provided rollback steps are clear.
Maria: SRE +1. I want quick post-deploy metric checks: errors, p99 latency, KV miss rate.
Alex: Thanks. kicking deploy.
deploy-bot: Deploy request received: image=redwood/runtime:2.14.4 override_canary=true pin_target=prod route=embeddings-main circuit_breaker=0.1 triggered_by=Alex
deploy-bot: Starting preflight smoke in staging...
deploy-bot: Staging smoke passed (healthcheck ok, kvcache warm).
deploy-bot: Proceeding to prod pin-and-rollforward (skipping standard canary due to expedite).
deploy-bot: Rolling pods (maxUnavailable=5%)...
deploy-bot: 25% rolled - checks running.
ops-oncall-bot: Alert suppression enabled for embeddings-main to avoid alert storm during roll (suppression id=esp-499001).
Alex: Monitoring logs: small spike then tailing off.
Maria: Metrics green: errors down to baseline, p99 stable.
Devon: Autoscaler behaved fine, no crashloops.
deploy-bot: Rollcomplete: all pods running image=2.14.4, rollout_duration=3m12s.
Alex: Leaving circuit-breaker at 0.1 for 30m, then restore to 1.0 if stable. Marking release note: see snippet below.
Alex: ```
Release: embeddings runtime hotfix 2.14.4
- Reason: config key name drift causing rare 5xxs on embeddings route
- Action: pin runtime to 2.14.4; small migration: key rename handled in fallback
- Rollback: rollback image to 2.14.3 via deploy-bot command: `deploy-bot rollback embeddings-main 2.14.3`
- Post-checks: errors, p99, kv miss rate observed for 30m
```
Jen: Thanks — will file the short release note and close the incident if no regressions in 60m.
Sam: Confirmed +1 logged. Good job getting this in quickly. :thumbsup:
Alex: Closing thread, will update after 60m stability window.
